application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The submitted landscaping plan fails to provide the level of detail in respect of soft and hard landscaping in line with the requirements of Condition 3, including types of species and a planting schedule as well as details of landscape maintenance and implementation a design/specification for the refuse storage, means of enclosure, hard surfaces and external lighting, all of which are required to ensure that these are appropriate in terms of design and visual and neighbouring amenity. It has not therefore been demonstrated that the development will preserve and enhance the visual amenities of the locality and provide adequate facilities in compliance with policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12, DMHB 14, DMEI 1 and DMT 2, DMT 5 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020) and Policy G5 and T6 of the London Plan (2021).
description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 3 (landscape scheme) of planning permission ref. 23149/APP/2025/1793, dated 21-08-2025 (Conversion of single dwelling house into 2 self-contained flats involving the erection of single-storey rear extension, conversion of roof space including rear dormer and front rooflights, amendments to fenestration and associated parking and landscaping.)
